_about: Brownstone Bloom 'one more round of missing mats' (her l-final-brownstone note), built Oct 21. Pool = every visible FYM mat from a partner or allowed brand that was NOT in the Oct 18 swipe book (scripts/albumcard/specs/brownstone_bloom_inputs/items.json, 123 mats) and not already in the 31 or her 9 cancels, plus Amanda Toppe's 9 full-size mats from amandatoppeart.com/mahjong (none were in the swipe book; only City Queen was in FYM). Screened by eye against the Brownstone palette (ivory, lavender, wine, olive, chocolate, saffron), transitional/earthy tone (doc 76). No holiday, no Mahjong Studios, no Paige Spearin, no non-partners outside nonpartner_allow.json.
